title: T2 flat for sale in Rua das Trinas
description: We have an incredible suggestion, a T2+1 fraction located in one of the privileged areas of Lisbon, ideal for both investment and own housing.Located next to the French Embassy, in the charming neighbourhood of Santos, in the parish of Estrela, this fraction is in a typical Lisbon building from the 30s, with its façade adorned by beautiful traditional tiles. It can be accessed both from the street and from the internal staircase of the building, offering practicality and autonomy.The fraction is habitable, although it needs modernisation, especially in the kitchen and bathroom, which represents an excellent opportunity to create a bespoke space, increasing its value. The configuration includes a living/entrance room, an interior room, two bedrooms, kitchen, a bathroom and a small pantry, providing comfort and functionality.The area is full of culture, with museums, art galleries and neighbourhoods, such as Lapa and Estrela, where the famous Jardim da Estrela and the Basilica, with the same name, offer moments of leisure and tranquillity. For those who like nightlife and gastronomy, there are several options of restaurants, fado houses and the traditional Mercado da Ribeira, a symbol of Portuguese architecture, with a good variety of different types of restaurants and terraces.In addition, the area has easy access to public transport, such as the tram, buses and Metro within a 15-minute walk, as well as the boat to cross the Tagus River, making it easier for you to get around the city.Whether to invest or live, this is a unique opportunity to acquire a property with potential for appreciation in a privileged location. We will be available for more information, such as scheduling a visit!__________Private Luxury Real Estate is a consultancy specialised in the marketing of luxury properties in the premium areas of Portugal.We provide a distinguished service of excellence, always taking into account that, behind each real estate transaction, there is a person or a family.The company aims to act in the best interest of its clients, offering discretion, expertise and professionalism, in order to establish lasting relationships with them.Maximum customer satisfaction is a vital point for the success of Private Luxury Real Estate. Energy Rating: D ref: NR8869.
